technical.summary: Short-term momentum is bullish with rising RSI and positive volume signals, but price remains below key moving averages (50/200) and Ichimoku cloud, creating conflicting intermediate-term bearish structure; moderate confluence with elevated overbought conditions limits high-probability entry.

fundamental.summary: FDS shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 16 days present elevated risk with no supporting fundamental catalysts.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (VIX-equivalent score 11) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but absent recent congressional conviction and news data limits conviction; neutral AAII sentiment suggests mixed institutional positioning.

risk.summary: Crisis-level VIX (346.7), flat yield curve, and earnings in 16 days create a highly adverse macro backdrop for FDS trading.

debate.key_bull_argument: Short-term momentum (RSI rising, OBV rising, force index cross-up, supertrend bullish) with price near support (361.14) offers technical entry point in extreme fear environment (contrarian buy signal).
debate.key_bear_argument: Price structurally below all key moving averages (EMA/SMA 50/200), Ichimoku cloud, and earnings risk in 16 days combined with crisis-level VIX (346.7), zero fundamental support, and no institutional conviction create unacceptable risk-reward for swing entry.

decision.entry_rationale: Short-term momentum signals (RSI rising, OBV rising, supertrend bullish) offer technical confluence at support, and extreme fear environment presents contrarian opportunity. However, structural bearish setup (price below EMA/SMA 50/200, Ichimoku cloud) combined with earnings risk in 16 days and crisis-level macro backdrop (VIX 346.7) create unacceptable risk-reward asymmetry.
